_description: Referral scenario — form payload for tests/referral.spec.ts. Filled into the Referral form (load/visit-form/{visitId}/referrals, opened from the visit edit page's 'Referrals' tab) of the target visit (visitId from config/config.json → visitId). Static values are chosen from the real option lists / checkbox labels on staging: referral_type uses the option text 'Elective', referral_hospital_id the option text 'Dr. Soliman Fakeeh Hospital', print checkboxes their LABEL texts (what the readback returns), dates 'YYYY-MM-DD', and reason/comments are free-text. The signature/attachment file uploads (uploadFile, inputGroupFileImage) are intentionally absent. The visit ID itself is NOT here — it lives in config/config.json so all tests share one value.

_config._comment: No extra test parameters — the scenario is the form payload only.

_fields.referralReason: Patient referred for elective specialist follow-up.
_fields.comments: Referral record created by the E2E test.
